body:
Release notes are drafted from the work Solace already records, then approved by the human.

- When the human asks for notes on a release, an agent drafts them from the tasks, features and decisions completed since the previous release. Notes are never drafted on their own.
- The draft groups changes by feature and links each entry to its task.
- The human edits and approves the notes as they would a proposal; approved notes are stored with the release.

Depends on: build: artifacts and versions (complete).
title: build: release notes from tasks
